name: satmap-bot
title: SatMap Discord Bot
description: Slash commands for a Satisfactory server that runs the SatMap mod, answered live from the game: /status, /online, /power, /stock, /rates, /machines, /logistics, /nodes, /alerts, /elevator, /digest, /harddrives, /todo. Item, machine and resource names are suggested as you type. Optional: a live status board kept up to date in one message, news (joined, left, server up or down) and alerts that are marked cleared when put right. The bot's token is read from the secret store: add a secret named SATMAP_TOKEN (Discord developer portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token; a bot of its own, not the DCS bot's) before you start it. It only reads SatMap's pages (port 8765 of the game server) and never sends anything to the game. SatMap's own webhook can post news and alerts too: use the bot's or the webhook's, not both.

variables.name: SATMAP_GUILD_ID
variables.label: Discord server ID
variables.description: Right-click your server → Copy Server ID (Developer Mode). Commands register there instantly; empty registers them everywhere the bot is, which can take an hour.

variables.name: SATMAP_URL
variables.label: SatMap address
variables.description: Where the game server's SatMap answers, as seen from a container on this host. A game server on this machine (Pelican included): http://host.docker.internal:8765

variables.name: SATMAP_MAP_URL
variables.label: Map link
variables.description: Optional link on every answer (an "Open the map" button), e.g. https://satmap.example.com/

variables.name: SATMAP_CHANNEL_IDS
variables.label: Command channels
variables.description: Comma-separated channel IDs where answers are public; asked anywhere else, only the asker sees the answer. Empty: public everywhere

variables.name: SATMAP_ROLE_IDS
variables.label: Allowed roles
variables.description: Comma-separated role IDs that may use the commands. Empty: everyone

variables.name: SATMAP_BOARD_CHANNEL_ID
variables.label: Live board channel
variables.description: A channel ID: the bot keeps one status message there up to date. Empty: no board

variables.name: SATMAP_NEWS_CHANNEL_ID
variables.label: News channel
variables.description: A channel ID for joined, left and server up or down. Empty: off (leave it off if SatMap's webhook already posts these)

variables.name: SATMAP_ALERTS_CHANNEL_ID
variables.label: Alerts channel
variables.description: A channel ID for alerts (blown fuse, no fuel, machines standing still), marked cleared when put right. Empty: off (leave it off if SatMap's webhook already posts these)

variables.name: SATMAP_ALERTS_MENTION
variables.label: Ping on a fault
variables.description: Optional: who to ping when a fault is posted, e.g. <@&ROLE_ID> or <@USER_ID>
